properties.name: Pimmit Run
properties.protect: Keep dogs on a lead near the stream. Do not dump soil or leaves into the water.

properties.name: Difficult Run
properties.protect: Keep trees on the banks. Do not pick rare plants. Watch birds from the trail.

properties.name: Accotink Creek
properties.protect: Stay on marked paths. Do not feed wildlife. Leave native plants in place.

properties.name: Cameron Run
properties.protect: Use the trail. Do not enter restoration plantings. Report trash near the water.

properties.name: Four Mile Run
properties.protect: Protect stream buffers. Do not cut native shrubs. Watch for nesting birds.

properties.name: Pohick Creek
properties.protect: Stay out of wet meadows. Do not collect frogs or plants. Pack out all trash.

properties.name: Cub Run
properties.protect: Keep to the path in parks. Do not mow or clear stream banks. Leave snags for wildlife.

properties.name: Scotts Run
properties.protect: Stay on the gorge trail. Do not climb rare rock plants. Keep noise low for wildlife.

properties.name: Dogue Creek
properties.protect: Do not walk through wetlands. Leave turtles and herons alone. Keep the banks planted.

properties.name: Sugarland Run
properties.protect: Protect the floodplain woods. Do not plant invasive species. Keep pets out of nests.
